causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Conditions at the time saw demand around 100MW higher than forecast four hours to dispatch.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: At around 3pm, constraints were invoked, effective immediately, to ramp down the import capability across the Heywood interconnector from 460MW to 200MW. This was in preparation for an outage of the South East to Tailem Bend line, in South Australia, which was out of service from around 3.45pm to 4.05pm.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Most of this was from reductions in availability at NRG Flinders Osborne and Playford stations by 10MW and 30MW respectively.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: As part of a day-ahead offer, TRU Energy set up a step change in the price of capacity at Torrens Island for the period between 3pm and 4pm. This step change saw 370MW of capacity, which was priced at less than $300/MWh for most of the day, replaced with prices of $5 000/MWh from 3.05pm.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: As a result of the short notice outage, flows from Victoria were around 260MW lower than forecast four and 12 hours ahead.

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: At around 3pm, constraints were invoked, effective immediately, to ramp down the import capability across the Heywood interconnector from 460MW to 200MW.

interconnectors_named.name: MurrayLink interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: Flows across the MurrayLink interconnector were as forecast.

intervals.quote: eight 5-minute dispatch interval prices of $5 000/MWh between 3.25pm and 4pm. The half-hour spot price at 4pm was also $5 000/MWh

network_outages.quote: The combination of the network outage, higher than forecast demand and the offer profile in SA contributed to the price reaching $5 000/MWh at 4pm.

peak_price.quote: The half-hour spot price at 4pm was also $5 000/MWh

rebid_set_price.quote: Rebidding did not contribute to the spot price reaching $5 000/MWh.
